cs.t: I used to use (and still own) one of those PowerBook G3 laptops where you could swap the media bay for a CD-RW, a floppy, or a Zip drive, or just more batteries.  With modern Li-ion battery technology in both the main battery and the media bay, that thing ran for 20+ hours.  It was amazing.
cs.th: HP made a laptop slightly thicker to add 3 hours of battery life
